svg.title: Shared item, warehouse, and employee records
svg.desc: Shared item, warehouse, and employee records. Which identifiers let an investigation move across processes? Primary tables: Item, Warehouse, Employee. These records recur as shared references in process views. Item account mappings, employee approvals, and warehouse context answer different questions; a shared item does not identify one receipt-to-issue transaction.
